BNGR.description: Boundary Group (BNGR). Each key is the boundary group id; NAME sets the group name and AUTOTYPE flags an auto-generated creep/shrinkage boundary group.

AUTOTYPE.description: Auto-generation type for boundary groups auto-created for creep/shrinkage in composite sections. 0 = normal/manual boundary group, non-zero flags an auto-generated group. Leave 0 for user-defined groups.
